name: Solidarity Wealth Tax (President Hage Geingob, 2015-2016)
detail: Announced as a "Solidarity Wealth Tax" but described as applying "to the wealthy in high income brackets" for a limited period: an income-based surcharge, not a tax on net wealth. Geingob (died February 2024) and Finance Minister Calle Schlettwein are not recorded.

name: Dividend withholding tax (2025/26 mid-year budget review) and the NamRA high-net-worth unit
detail: A 10% dividend tax and a revenue-agency unit for wealthy individuals tax income and compliance, not the stock of wealth.

name: Elifas Dingara and Tobie Aupindi (Swapo MPs)
detail: Proposals on a N$1 million payout for every Namibian and on taxing mineral rents; neither asks for a tax on wealth.

name: Basic Income Grant Coalition (Rinaani Musutua)
detail: The 2024 submission reportedly named "a relatively small wealth tax", but the only page found (Namibian Sun, 17 September 2024) is behind a paywall and shows only the lede, and the coalition's own submission was not found. Kept as an open lead, not a row. Musutua's claw-back of the grant from the 1 763 richest individuals is a repayment through income tax, not a wealth tax.
